data_contract.corpus: MAIN 210000 matches: TRAIN 15.14 (74673), VALIDATION 15.15 (74748), TEST 15.16 (60579); external KR_16.13, KR_16.14_pilot, KR_16.15, NA1_16.13 separately
data_contract.horizon: h90 only; h60/h120 NOT refit in this bounded stage
data_contract.label: Y = 1[delta_h90 > 0] from parent labels unchanged; TRAIN p_pre/Y from own-match-excluded OOF V (verified, V not refit)
data_contract.cohorts: T: known min(cluster_blue, cluster_red) >= 4; N: known min < 4; parent cohort arrays joined row-exact
data_contract.count_mismatch_policy: any mismatch blocks fitting / evaluation until traced
data_contract.roles: TRAIN = parent sub_role fold0..4; Q_CAL / Q_SELECT = parent VALIDATION roles; V_CAL / V_SELECT unused
data_contract.final_training: ALL eligible cohort TRAIN rows; no balanced-only training, per-class or delta reweighting, no new exclusions

inputs.learners: predictor_sets["ridge"] of parent q_pre_only_schema.json in exact order (352 numeric incl. p_pre_V; no champion IDs, no snapshot_age)
inputs.finiteness: assert finite on every TRAIN/Q_CAL/Q_SELECT/evaluation input row; stop and document otherwise
inputs.preprocessing: SimpleImputer(median) then StandardScaler, both fit on the applicable TRAIN subset (fit90 in the stop phase; all cohort TRAIN in the refit)
inputs.no_additions: no draft / role / position / cohort / post-state / final winner inputs

optimizer.shuffle: uniform permutation per epoch from a CPU torch.Generator seeded with the seed

families.loss: minibatch mean(w_i * BCEWithLogits_i), uniform shuffled minibatches, no per-batch renormalisation, no weighted sampler; population loss sum(w*BCE)/sum(w) (fixture in the contract tests)
families.prediction: mean raw probability over seeds 7, 42, 123 (never best seed); seed probabilities stored
families.prediction_definition: saved float32 weights evaluated on CPU in float64, torch threads 1, chunk 8192 rows; the stop curve is a GPU float32 diagnostic

stopping.allocation: int(sha256('iq20260915_stop:'+match_id).hexdigest()[:8],16) % 10 == 0 -> stop10 (iq allocation; same matches as the LightGBM arm, same for T and N)
stopping.preprocessing: imputer + scaler fit on fit90 rows only in the stop phase
stopping.metric: match-weighted Brier on stop10 after every epoch (weights recomputed inside stop10; GPU float32, eval mode)
stopping.ties: strict improvement required -> earlier epoch kept (first minimum)
stopping.refit: from scratch on ALL cohort TRAIN rows, preprocessing refit there, exactly best_epoch epochs, same seed, per config and seed
stopping.never: Q_CAL / Q_SELECT / TEST never used for stopping

families.determinism: torch.manual_seed(seed), CPU generator for minibatch order, cudnn deterministic, torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
families.weights: fc20260915_common.weights: equal total weight per match within EVERY fit subset (TRAIN, fit90, stop10, Q_CAL, Q_SELECT, evaluation cell), row mean 1
families.comparison_note: Both families read the identical 352 inputs as the iq full logistic / LightGBM; the PT baseline reads only p_pre and time. Six configurations per family is a bounded search convention, not equal computation or global optimality.

calibration_selection.calibrators: raw identity; sigmoid and isotonic fit on cohort Q_CAL only via cr20260915_common.fit_calibrators (sigmoid: LogisticRegression(C=1e6, max_iter=1000) on logit(clip(raw, 1e-8)); no positive-slope constraint; isotonic out_of_bounds=clip)
calibration_selection.order: three-seed raw mean first, then calibration (never per seed)
calibration_selection.q_cal_weights: weights(match ids of cohort Q_CAL rows)
calibration_selection.q_select_weights: weights(match ids of cohort Q_SELECT rows)
calibration_selection.rule: rank all 18 joint candidates of a family by cohort Q_SELECT match-weighted Brier, then log loss, then candidate name (lexical)
calibration_selection.metric_implementation: fc20260915_common.evaluate (sklearn brier_score_loss / log_loss with match weights)
calibration_selection.overall_mlp_families: same rule over the 36 joint candidates of the two MLP families (alias overall_winner_mlp_families)
calibration_selection.five_family_ranking: information only: same rule over the iq PT / logistic / LightGBM winners and the two MLP winners on the identical cohort Q_SELECT rows (iq winners not refit)
calibration_selection.no_subset_selection: no selection within balanced / time / external subsets
calibration_selection.freeze: frozen_manifest.json with all bundles, selections and hashes for BOTH cohorts, plus the iq frozen manifest and iq evaluation prediction file hashes, before any TEST/external array or iq/parent TEST prediction is opened; sealed access gated on THIS run's freeze
calibration_selection.reload: all saved bundles reloaded and predictions compared exactly before the freeze

cells.membership: frozen p_pre and pre time only; common to all models; no small-delta exclusion; empty/single-class cells reported

iq.source: outputs/incremental_q_training_20260915/eval/predictions/<set>_h90_<cohort>.npz named__* columns joined by exact (match, s_ms)
iq.label: frozen iq winners (same protocol, older stage) and legacy references with an older fixed fitting budget

evaluation.metrics: rows, distinct matches, positives / rate, match-weighted Brier / log loss / AUC, calibration intercept / slope (descriptive), fixed 10-bin reliability incl. empty bins, ECE, exact 0/1 probability counts; weights recomputed inside each cell; AUC NA for single-class cells; <30 matches marked sparse without intervals or broad conclusions

bootstrap.paired: same draw for all models in a cell
bootstrap.where: all / B40 / B45 cells of every set and cohort with >= 30 matches and both label classes; all six planned contrasts
bootstrap.time_cells: point estimates and reliability only; CI explicitly not computed
bootstrap.implementation: per-match weighted loss sums; exact weighted AUC (ties 1/2); degenerate replicates counted
bootstrap.scope: fixed-model evaluation uncertainty only; no multiple-comparison adjustment

not_tested: final-W causal effects; semantic correctness of Y
interpretation_choices: Preprocessing (median imputer, StandardScaler) is fit on unweighted rows of the applicable TRAIN subset, as in the parent pipelines; the model loss uses the equal-per-match weights.
The refit uses the same seed as the stop phase, so the initial weights coincide; the data (all TRAIN rows) and the fixed epoch count differ.
A candidate needs finite Q_CAL/Q_SELECT predictions to be eligible; MLP fits have no convergence criterion beyond the epoch rule.
Predictions are defined on CPU in float64 (device-independent); GPU float32 stop-curve values may differ in the last digits from a CPU recomputation and are diagnostics only.

Smoke = TRAIN-only rows of matches with sha256('iq20260915_smoke_subset:'+match)[:8] mod 8 == 0 and pseudo roles fold0-2 TRAIN / fold3 Q_CAL / fold4 Q_SELECT, output under smoke_train_only/, identical settings; smoke evaluation uses pseudo Q_SELECT rows and stand-in comparator columns; smoke models are never final models.
